answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and scoped to the primary region during peak settlement, so a region shift is the intervention that can restore availability without dropping writes. Rollback is forbidden by the security-patch constraint. Circuit breaking would fail customer writes. Read-replica routing and extra primary capacity are weaker fits: the former targets read/report offload, the latter stays inside the already-degraded region. memory_b2 is the closest prior case and is the one record worth verifying. Scale stays a controlled standard shift, not a blind full cut, because settlement is peak and failover can still put in-flight or downstream settlement value at risk. Root cause remains uncertain (regional fault vs release pressure vs saturation).
